title: Position: Beyond Assistance – Reimagining LLMs as Ethical and Adaptive Co-Creators in Mental Health Care

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing different splits in the test set based on demographic information and using demographic-aware prompting to evaluate potential biases in model-generated responses across specific demographic groups.

Evaluating a proposed Cultural Sensitivity Index (CSI) metric, which uses expert evaluators to assign a cultural appropriateness alignment score based on the model's ability to avoid cultural stereotypes, understand nuanced cultural norms, and provide contextually relevant advice.
